{{Short description|Statistician and data scientist}}
{{Use mdy dates|date=July 2025}}

'''Jinchi Lv''' is a statistician, data scientist, a chaired professor in the Data Sciences and Operations department of the [[USC Marshall School of Business|Marshall School of Business]], and professor of mathematics at the [[University of Southern California]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.marshall.usc.edu/personnel/jinchi-lv|title=Jinchi Lv|website=USC Marshall School of Business}}</ref> He is a co-developer of several data science learning, inference methods and algorithms for feature screening, model selection with misspecification, large Gaussian graphical models, and feature selection with controlled error rates such as the sure independence screening (SIS), the generalized Bayesian information criterion with prior probability (GBICp), the innovated scalable efficient estimation (ISEE), and the model-X knockoffs (MXK). He is an elected fellow of the [[American Statistical Association]], the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]], and the Asia-Pacific Artificial Intelligence Association, and the recipient of the [[Royal Statistical Society]]{{`}}s Guy Medal in Bronze.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.amstat.org/asa/files/pdfs/2020-ASAFellowsAnnouncement.pdf|title=A list of 2020 ASA Fellows - American Statistical Association}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://imstat.org/honored-ims-fellows/|title=Institute of Mathematical Statistics &#124; Honored IMS Fellows}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://rss.org.uk/RSS/media/File-library/Events/Honours/previous_recipients_of_-Society_awards-2022.pdf|title=A list of previous recipients of the Society's honours (PDF) since 109 - Royal Statistical Society}}</ref>

He chairs the Data Sciences and Operations (DSO) department at USC Marshall. Also, he has served on several university-level academic committees such as the USC UCAPT committee (university committee on appointments, promotions, and tenure), the USC deadlines and leaves committee, and the USC research committee.
